standard_prerequisites.name: Finiteness of the cohomology modules of the dual and the vanishing criterion for finitely generated modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 3899-3902)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a localizing element killing the unwanted cohomology.

core_obligations: Denseness: at a generic point of the support the depth of the localisation is zero, so that point lies in the locus (proof lines 3885-3889)
One inclusion: at a point of the locus the dual of the module has a unique nonzero cohomology module, by the Cohen-Macaulay criterion (proof lines 3890-3898)

The other inclusion: since only finitely many cohomology modules are nonzero and each is finitely generated, a localizing element kills all the unwanted ones, so a neighbourhood of the point lies in the locus (proof lines 3899-3903)
proof_roadmap: 稠密性：Supp(M) 的泛点处 depth = dim = 0 ⇒ 该点属于 U。
U 中一点 p：由局部 CM 判据，RHom_A(M, ω_A^•)_p 只有一个非零上同调模，设为 i_0 度。
该复形的非零上同调模只有有限多个且各自有限生成 ⇒ 存在 f ∉ p 使 (H^i)_f = 0 (i ≠ i_0) ⇒ D(f) ⊂ U。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the set of points where the target module is Cohen-Macaulay is open with closure equal to the support (author lemma at source lines 3874-3883, label lemma-CM-open). The proof (source lines 3885-3904) proves denseness at the generic points of the support, then identifies membership in the locus with the dual having a unique nonzero cohomology module, and uses finiteness of those modules to localise away the unwanted ones, giving an open neighbourhood (proof lines 3885-3903). The localisation step is the substance. H3.
